title: Creamy Japanese Tofu Course
description: A delicious and elegant Japanese-inspired dish featuring creamy tofu as the main ingredient. This recipe is perfect for a special occasion or a romantic dinner.
instructions: 1. In a small bowl, whisk together the almond milk, cornstarch, and matcha powder until smooth.
2. In a medium saucepan, combine the almond milk mixture, sugar, and vanilla extract. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture comes to a boil.
3. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2-3 minutes, or until the mixture has thickened.
4. In a separate bowl, whisk together the cubed tofu and matcha powder until the tofu is evenly coated.
5. Add the tofu to the saucepan and stir to combine.
6. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the tofu is heated through.
7. Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the yummy.
8. Serve the creamy Japanese tofu course immediately, garnished with additional matcha powder if desired.
